title: NASA operator disconnects Gary during hack

tellings.quote: obviously when that guy right clicked the LAN icon and disconnected me, that was NAZA.

plain: Around 2001 or 2002, while Gary McKinnon was inside NASA computers from the UK, someone at NASA noticed him and cut him off by right-clicking the network icon and disconnecting him. McKinnon is a British hacker, and he tells Michels this as his own experience. He brings up British Telecom, the UK phone company, as he tells it, and says 'that was NASA' on the other end, meaning a real person caught him in the act.
